dedupe_keys.name: servitudes de protection des centres radio electriques emetteurs recepteurs contre les obstacles

description: Servitudes de protection des centres radio-électriques émetteurs-récepteurs contre les obstacles is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires du Bas-Rhin (67). Easement for the protection of radio transmission and reception centres against obstacles established pursuant to Articles: Articles L. 54 to L. 56-1 of the Post and Electronic Communications Code; Article L. 5113-1 of the Defence Code; Articles R. 21 to R. 26 and R.39 of the Postal and Electronic Communications Code. Coverage: Direction Départementale des Territoires du Bas-Rhin (67). The portal shows the English title as "Protective easements of radio-transceiver centres against obstacles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction Départementale des Territoires du Bas-Rhin (67). Its keywords include radio-electrique, servitude-d-utilite-publique, reception, emission, bas-rhin. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2016-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
